description:
£140 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to bring to the student lettings market this well presented three bedroom ground floor flat, ideally situated on Forsyth Road in the popular area of Jesmond.

The property briefly comprises a bright open-plan living room and kitchen, a modern shower room and three double bedrooms, each benefiting from a desk and storage space, making it ideal for student living. Further benefits include gas central heating, double glazing and a private rear yard.

Situated in a fantastic central location, the property is within easy reach of Jesmond Metro Station and the local shops on Brentwood Avenue. There is also a great selection of cafés, bars and restaurants nearby, while Newcastle city centre is within walking distance. For those travelling further afield, the property offers convenient road access to the A1 Western Bypass and surrounding areas.

Think this could be your next student home? We'd love to show you around! Contact My Property Box today and speak to our friendly Lettings Team to arrange your viewing. We look forward to hearing from you!
